source.section: Table 49 Ordering information (see also Section 3.1.7 Memory, Table 50 MPN Decoder)

notes: 1024 KB total SRAM in three banks (512 + 256 + 256 KB) is fully present in hardware at a single shared physical address range (0x0800 0000-0x080F FFFF), confirmed in the datasheet's memory map as one region equally accessible to both CPU cores -- the chip does not reserve, split, or otherwise limit any portion of this 1024 KB to one core over the other. A dual-core firmware project typically partitions this shared space between the two cores' images, but that partitioning is a linker/RTOS decision made by the firmware author, not a hardware limitation: a single-core (or single-image) use of the chip, such as running TFLM entirely on the Cortex-M4, can address the full 1024 KB. Confirmed via the exact part row in Table 49 (Ordering information) and independently via the MPN memory-size decode in Table 50, not just the family's 'up to 1 MB' headline figure -- the sibling CY8C6248xxx parts in the same family only get 512 KB. total_flash_bytes (2048 KB) comes from the same Table 49 row, 'Flash (KB)' column -- the datasheet separately lists a 32-KB auxiliary flash (AUXflash) and a 32-KB supervisory flash (SFlash), both excluded here since they are calibration/protection regions, not general application code/data storage; 2048 KB is the figure Infineon itself uses to differentiate this part from the sibling CY8C6248xxx parts (1024 KB).
